name: statement
title: Draft invoice balance statement
for_each: select id,name from customers order by name

sections.title: Invoice balances
sections.note: Internal draft. Reconcile unallocated credits and payments in your accounting system before sending. Currency totals stay separate.
sections.sql: select number,currency,issued_on,due_on,total_cents,outstanding_cents,balance_as_of,next_action from invoice_work where customer_id=$1 order by currency,due_on

sections.title: Totals by currency
sections.sql: select currency,sum(outstanding_cents) as outstanding_cents from invoices where customer_id=$1 group by currency order by currency

name: dispute-brief
title: Internal dispute review brief
for_each: select d.id,w.number as name from disputes d join invoice_work w on w.id=d.invoice_id where d.status='open'

sections.title: Issue and next review
sections.sql: select w.customer,w.number,w.currency,w.outstanding_cents,d.reason,d.owner,d.review_on,d.evidence from disputes d join invoice_work w on w.id=d.invoice_id where d.id=$1

name: promise-record
title: Internal payment promise record
for_each: select id,id as name from promises

sections.title: Commitment and status
sections.note: A recorded promise does not change the invoice balance and is not proof of payment.
